title: R1 compositional whole-group code for complete typed mixture accounts
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. An explicit finite writing rival to S0/R0: each operator absorbs its atomic material, reference and numerical arguments into one complete group; fixed holes own every nested expression. One global47-atom prefix code plus exactly2entry and6agreement categories realizes all groups. S0 recipe semantics remain unchanged; complete source alternatives and a newly generated different-grade account are supplied. No target decoder, count selection or historical format license.

design.mechanism: Retain the existing finite S0 typed mixture language and its immutable recipe references. For each non-atomic constructor emit its head, all atomic arguments in their original slots, and HOLE for each nested child; subsequently emit each nested child in argument order. Every resulting core is one written group, with a deterministic entry prefix and result-type/mixed-argument agreement suffix. This is a recursive compositional code, not a per-word meaning dictionary. Every complete account consumes all groups and all holes.
design.unit: A complete S0 account with its full header and1–3branches, including all references, operations, assertions and terminal yields. A group combines an operator with its atomic argument structure. Program size varies under the existing finite grammar; none of the example group counts is a target requirement.
design.contrast: IDEA000124 already proposed one opcode/register/rational instruction per group; this is not claimed novel. Its physical-stock consumption and missing endpoint stop remain. S0/R0 already supports reusable recipe definitions; R1 changes no semantics. Its new written consequence is grouping atomic arguments with their operator plus fixed context/shape agreement. PORTION(A,NUM2) is three R0groups but one R1group. GDT882 does not permit claiming a constant additive line invariant; GDT903 does not identify a rule from free automaton compatibility. GDT708/741 fitted fragment/attachment grammars license no old gloss or marker. All these primaries were read.
design.prediction: Under one global code, every operator/atomic-argument combination has the specified shared interior construction, every HOLE has one correctly typed subtree, and every mandatory context/agreement code is forced. The same SETR0-HOLE core at branch entry versus after a used SETQ declaration must differ in entry marker; PORTION cannot occupy that first-statement position and is not offered as a false context contrast. Source arithmetic must separately satisfy every written assertion and header. A legal new recipe with weights16,4,0has mass20but fine64, contradicting targetgrade5 despite successful symbolic encoding.

semantic_model.material_policy: Immutable recipe vectors. Repeating a recipe reference reuses a definition, not physical stock. Different alternatives may have different vectors and histories while sharing mass/fine goals. No requirement that a second branch by itself identify any meanings.

writing_family.atom_spelling: TYPE emits its type atom; NUM and references emit their shared prefix followed by shared digit atoms. MIXED emits MIXED plus all three complete NUM component spellings. No whole rational is assigned a new independent value.
writing_family.core_production: head(C) slot(a1)...slot(ak); atomic slot emits its complete atom spelling; non-atomic slot emits HOLE. SETQ/SETR indices are shared decimal digits in the head. Emit non-atomic child cores recursively in original argument order.
writing_family.header: GRADES(A,NUM(a),B,NUM(b),C,NUM(c)), TARGET(NUM(t)), TOTAL(NUM(m)), then FIRST/ALTERNATIVELY and all branch statements.
writing_family.whole_group: h(ENTRY[e]) concatenated with h(each core atom) concatenated with h(AGREE[type,mixed]); exactly one space between whole groups, none inside.
writing_family.entry_function: e=0 iff first group ofaccount or first group after FIRST/ALTERNATIVELY; otherwise e=1. No other contexts or transitions.

agreement_function.S: All statement, header and branch heads
agreement_function.mixed_flag: 1 iff the emitted core absorbs a MIXED atomic argument;0otherwise. This is written shape, not an inferred fractional value of a deferred subtree.

writing_family.spacing: A physical line break may replace a group-separating space while remaining recorded, with no semantic/context reset. No internal spaces, arbitrary erasure, comments or other whitespace changes.
writing_family.finite_limit_policy: Retains R0alphabet/length and S0program bounds. Added grouping and exactly9new structural atoms are explicit modern model assumptions, not fitted historical conventions.
writing_family.whole_form_limit: The cross-condition between operator result type and absorbed mixed-number shape is one finite candidate interaction. It does not claim to explain all known whole-form residuals.
